title: Hongguo FYP methods and measurement evidence pack
scope: Focused methods evidence; not a complete final report or exhaustive short-drama systematic review.
research_questions: What public platform metrics actually measure and how to audit reliability.
What descriptive, predictive, and causal conclusions a 36-day selected-chart panel supports.
What a feasible undergraduate randomized social-information or cliffhanger experiment identifies.

papers.title: Beyond the margin of error: a systematic and replicable audit of the TikTok research API
papers.method_verified: Two-team, two-context comparison of TikTok Research API metadata/video availability and website front end.
papers.finding_verified: API and front-end engagement measures can disagree; discrepancies reported for pre-July-2024 data.
papers.inference_boundary: Requires an independent Hongguo source/construct audit; does not establish that Hongguo has the same errors.
papers.access_level_and_checks: publisher-indexed abstract; direct opening returned 403; exact Crossref DOI verified

papers.title: Engagement, user satisfaction, and the amplification of divisive content on social media
papers.method_verified: Preregistered audit comparing users engagement-ranked and reverse-chronological candidate feeds; randomized item presentation for survey evaluation.
papers.finding_verified: Engagement ranking and stated content preferences differ; effects depend on content category.
papers.inference_boundary: Not a randomized long-term field assignment of feed algorithms; not evidence about Hongguo.
papers.access_level_and_checks: author final preprint v6 full text and journal metadata verified
papers.date_or_version_note: Use 2025 journal year. Earlier v4 called the study randomized experiment; final v6 calls it algorithmic audit.

papers.title: How algorithmic confounding in recommendation systems increases homogeneity and decreases utility
papers.venue: Proceedings of the 12th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems
papers.method_verified: Simulation of repeated user-recommender interactions with data generated under previous recommendations.
papers.finding_verified: Recommendation exposure can confound learned user preferences through feedback.
papers.inference_boundary: Mechanism simulation; not proof that every real recommender or Hongguo exhibits the same effects.
papers.access_level_and_checks: Princeton author manuscript title/authors/abstract plus exact Crossref DOI
papers.date_or_version_note: ACM conference version 2018; first arXiv version 2017.

papers.title: Social Influence Bias: A Randomized Experiment
papers.method_verified: Randomized initial positive/negative rating interventions on a social news site; subsequent rating behavior observed.
papers.finding_verified: Prior social information causally altered later rating behavior, with asymmetric positive/negative responses.
papers.inference_boundary: Effect size cannot be assumed for short-drama selection; observed high ratings alone confound quality and social influence.
papers.access_level_and_checks: PubMed original abstract, author explanation, exact Crossref DOI

papers.title: The role of cliffhangers in serial entertainment: An experiment on cliffhangers’ effects on enjoyment, arousal, and intention to continue watching.
papers.method_verified: N=133; participants watched 3-4 episodes ending with/without a cliffhanger; self-report and physiological arousal measured.
papers.finding_verified: Higher arousal was reported without a corresponding increase in enjoyment or intention to continue.
papers.inference_boundary: Null findings do not prove a universal zero effect; not a mobile micro-drama field experiment.
papers.access_level_and_checks: Author institutional repository abstract/metadata and exact Crossref DOI; PDF tool returned unsupported octet-stream

papers.title: Predictive Analytics in Information Systems Research
papers.method_verified: Conceptual/methods essay with an explanatory TAM example converted to prediction.
papers.finding_verified: Explanatory and predictive modeling serve distinct goals; explanatory power does not imply predictive performance.
papers.inference_boundary: Predictive accuracy, coefficients, SHAP and feature importance do not identify causal effects.
papers.access_level_and_checks: AIS official original abstract and exact Crossref DOI
papers.date_or_version_note: The trailing 1 in the Crossref title is a footnote marker, removed from normalized title.

papers.title: REFORMS: Consensus-based Recommendations for Machine-learning-based Science
papers.method_verified: Literature-informed consensus reporting checklist for machine-learning-based science.
papers.finding_verified: Requires clear study goals, data quality, preprocessing, modeling, leakage controls, metrics, uncertainty and scope.
papers.inference_boundary: Checklist does not repair inadequate data or automatically validate causal interpretations.
papers.access_level_and_checks: Crossref exact DOI; original abstract/checklist text retrieved via PMC index and author institution; Science direct returned 403

papers.title: Revisiting Event-Study Designs: Robust and Efficient Estimation
papers.method_verified: Identification framework and imputation estimator for staggered treatment timing and heterogeneous effects; simulations and application.
papers.finding_verified: Conventional TWFE event studies can fail to estimate a relevant average effect under heterogeneous treatment effects.
papers.inference_boundary: Modern estimators still require identification assumptions and do not make endogenous chart entry random.
papers.access_level_and_checks: Publisher primary text and exact Crossref DOI

papers.title: Causal Panel Analysis under Parallel Trends: Lessons from a Large Reanalysis Study
papers.method_verified: Replication/reanalysis of 49 published studies using six heterogeneous-effect-robust estimators, diagnostics and sensitivity analysis.
papers.finding_verified: Robust estimation is distinct from research design; many studies have weak support for parallel trends or low power under violations.
papers.inference_boundary: Nonsignificant pretrends do not establish parallel trends; FE specification alone does not establish causality.
papers.access_level_and_checks: Publisher full text and exact Crossref DOI; 2026 corrigendum checked
papers.date_or_version_note: Online 2025-06-09, issue 2026-02. Corrigendum 10.1017/S0003055426101798 swaps two Figure 5 case panels; no case panel used here.

papers.title: Regression Discontinuity in Time: Considerations for Empirical Applications
papers.method_verified: Guide to regression discontinuity in time, discussing time-series dependence, bandwidth, short-/long-run effects and concurrent changes.
papers.finding_verified: Temporal discontinuities require different scrutiny than standard cross-sectional RD; a chosen date is not automatically an identifying cutoff.
papers.inference_boundary: An analyst-defined 3-day new-drama label does not establish a causal RD design.
papers.access_level_and_checks: Publisher primary metadata/abstract, author institution manuscript and exact Crossref DOI

additional_screened_not_in_core.title: Experimental Study of Inequality and Unpredictability in an Artificial Cultural Market
additional_screened_not_in_core.status: VERIFIED but not included among 10 core items
additional_screened_not_in_core.reason: Additional cultural-market social-information experiment; core already contains a randomized field social-information study.

design_judgments.chart_entry: Endogenous selection; FE/DID/event-study estimation does not itself identify a listing effect. DID does not require literal random assignment, but needs defensible identifying assumptions and untreated potential-outcome comparisons.
design_judgments.three_day_threshold: Researcher age label is not a discontinuous treatment assignment rule; requires a documented platform intervention and validated first-stage change.
design_judgments.danmaku_peak: Descriptive selective response; same-show FE does not remove scene/time-varying confounding; using peaks to define suspense and then as outcome is circular.
design_judgments.preferred_undergraduate_RCT: One randomized manipulation, one preregistered primary behavioral outcome, participant-level inference; conclusion limited to study population/material/context.
design_judgments.prediction: Chronological origin-based evaluation, labels mature by prediction time, train-only preprocessing, task-specific baselines; cold-start and future-time generalization assessed separately.
